item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00274","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C20","C09","C23"],"selected_candidate_label":"C20","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C20 contains highly distinctive language reproduced almost verbatim in the child’s assistance provision, including the same statutory authority, detailing of employees, designation of an executive officer, and assignment of functions. The child also closely adapts C20’s savings clause. Beyond literal overlap, both orders establish a presidential coordinating body composed of senior officials, charge it with coordinating agency activity, provide interagency staffing support, require reporting, and preserve existing statutory functions. These concrete correspondences make C20 a plausible material drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Each executive department the head of which is referred to in section 1 of this order shall, as may be necessary for the purpose of effectuating the provisions of this order, furnish assistance to the Council in accordance with section 214 of the act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691). Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Council, one of whom may serve as its executive officer, to perform such functions consistent with the purposes of this order as the Council may assign to them.","parent_excerpt":"Consonant with law, each agency represented on the Board shall, as may be necessary for the purpose of effectuating this order, furnish assistance to the Board in accordance with section 214 of the Act of May 3, 1945, 59 Stat. 134 (31 U.S.C. 691). Such assistance may include detailing employees to the Board, one of whom may serve as its Executive Officer, to perform such functions, consistent with the purposes of this order, as the Board may assign to them.","explanation":"This is an exceptionally close, extended textual match involving the same administrative machinery, with only Council/Board and minor introductory wording changed."},{"child_excerpt":"Nothing in this order shall be construed to abrogate, modify, or restrict any function vested by law in, or assigned pursuant to law to, any executive department or other agency of the Government or any officer thereof.","parent_excerpt":"Nothing in this order shall be construed either to confer upon the Board any function with respect to internal security or to in any manner abrogate or restrict any function vested by law in, or assigned pursuant to law to, any agency or head of agency.","explanation":"The child closely adapts C20’s distinctive savings clause while broadening its coverage and removing the internal-security qualification."},{"child_excerpt":"The Council shall seek to coordinate, stimulate, and improve the functions of Federal agencies with respect to the fitness of youth.","parent_excerpt":"In order to provide for the integrated implementation of national security policies by the several agencies, there is hereby established an Operations' Coordinating Board... The Board shall... advise with the agencies concerned as to... the coordination of the interdepartmental aspects...","explanation":"Both directives use a presidential body to coordinate activities distributed among multiple agencies, supporting the literal evidence with a parallel institutional function."}]}
